Start here

Three checks solve most alarm issues.

  1. 01
    Open Profile & Settings

    Confirm that Alarm permission shows “Allowed.” Camera and Photos are needed only for video actions.

  2. 02
    Open the alarm

    Check the time, repeat days, enabled status, selected goal, and content setup.

  3. 03
    Run a short test

    Set an alarm a few minutes ahead and keep the app installed while you verify the full wake-up flow.

Answers

The details, without the runaround.

Choose the issue that matches what you see in the app.

?HELP
01My alarm did not appear

Open Profile & Settings and confirm that Alarm permission is allowed. Then open the alarm and verify that it is enabled and includes the correct repeat day.

For a reliable release check, also test the final build on a physical iPhone while the screen is locked.

02I cannot select my video

Allow Photos access when prompted and choose a video under two minutes. If access was previously denied, change it from iOS Settings and return to the app.

03I cannot record a video

Camera access is required for the picture and microphone access is required for sound. Both can be reviewed in iOS Settings.

04How does “Done” unlock?

For a message alarm, “Done” unlocks after the reading duration you selected. For a video alarm, it unlocks after the selected motivation video reaches the end.

05How do I edit or delete an alarm?

Open the Alarms tab and select the alarm. You can change its time, goal, content, repeat days, snooze behavior, or enabled state. The delete action is available in the alarm details.

06Where are my personal videos stored?

Videos selected or recorded for an alarm stay in the app’s local storage on your iPhone. Read the privacy policy for more detail.

Still need help?

Send the useful details first.

When contacting the developer through the App Store listing, include your iPhone model, iOS version, app version, and the exact step where the problem occurred. Never send a personal motivation video.
